concierge.description: Front door for employee questions. Works out which specialist agent should answer (HR policy and leave balances, or expense checks) and asks it over A2A on the employee's behalf.

expense_check.description: Checks one expense against the travel and expense policy and returns a decision: approve, approve a capped amount, needs a receipt, needs manager approval, or reject. Deterministic rules, no LLM.

policy_qa.description: Answers HR policy questions (vacation, sick leave, parental leave, remote work, expenses, holidays) and looks up leave balances. Employees see only their own balance, managers their direct reports, HR everyone.
